release-coordinator: Quick notice: new night deploy policy rolling out. No non-critical merges between 00:00-04:00 PT starting 2026-03-27. Night canaries start at 0.5% for 30m then 5% if stable. Emergency rollback drill Wed 02:15 PT for two weeks. Ack if you own night jobs.

infra-oncall: ack. Will update rotation and CI blockers.

pj: how do we flag something as critical?

release-coordinator: Critical = security patch, data-loss fix, or outage mitigation. File /freeze-except with owner + tests + approvers. Label: night-critical.

qa-lead: we'll move nightly regression to 04:30 PT to avoid overlap.

anita: I'll join rollback drill and run through rollback steps with infra.

release-bot: policy NDW-1 published: https://intranet.redwood/policies/night-deploys. Drill NDW-1-DRILL-001 scheduled 2026-03-25T02:15:00PT.

release-coordinator: Action items: infra - enforce CI block; docs - publish runbook; teams - ack by EOD. I'll post summary to #general tomorrow. :mega:
